title: Google Slides
description: Google Slides as the signed-in Workspace user: read decks slide by slide, create them, edit their text, and comment — Sermon slides

guide.summary: Each caller's decks: text, notes, layouts, comments, guarded edits and indexed Slides JSON operations.
guide.content:
# Google Slides usage

Purpose: Sermon slides

Workspace delegation is configured. Each call acts as the account deployment code maps the caller to; an agent uses its pool owner unless one shared account is configured. No argument selects a subject.

Content windows: get_presentation defaults to 20 slides (maximum 100); get_page to 50 elements (maximum 500); list_layouts to 100 rows (maximum 500); list_comments to 50 threads (maximum 500). Slides has no vendor list pagination.

Generic thumbnails/preview links are refused; get_slide_thumbnail is the reviewed short-lived-link workflow. The generic batch retains only the 49 shipped request kinds; no extra preview methods are admitted.

## Find and read a deck

Slides cannot search or list decks. Find the file through Drive, or take the
presentation id from `/presentation/d/<id>/` in its URL. A presentation is a
Drive file; finding one does not grant permission to open it.

`get_presentation` reads text in page order, with speaker notes, alt text and
placeholder ids. `get_page` opens groups and reads a slide, layout, master or
notes page. A slide's `index` is zero-based. Resolve a layout's placeholders
with `list_layouts` and `get_page` before filling a new slide.
Named-read `fields` narrows data while preserving `truncated` cut disclosures.

Text and notes have independent continuation. Pass an element's `textCursor`
or a slide's `elementsCursor` to `get_page` with that slide's id; pass a
`notesCursor` with its `notesPageId`. A deck's `layoutsCursor` continues in
`list_layouts`. Content cursors bind to the deck's revision and the text they
continue; a changed deck requires a fresh read. Follow continuation even when
a result contains fewer rows than requested.

For styles, transforms, HTML comment content, anchors' ranges or other full
structural JSON, use `slides_api_read`. Operation details use the legacy
`presentationsId` spelling for presentations.get; pages and batch updates use
`presentationId`. These are path parameter names, not query arguments.
Spell colons and unreserved characters literally in hatch paths; encode other
characters within one id segment. Named tools handle their own id encoding.

In code, `const {data: reply} = await connecta.call("decks.slides_api_read",
{path: "/presentations/deck1"});` exposes the vendor presentation as
`reply.data`.
A direct call wraps that same `{status,data}` tool value in Connecta's result
delivery; follow its result handle for large JSON. Content cursors belong to
the named reading tools and are separate from that delivery handle.

`get_slide_thumbnail` returns a link that opens as the delegated person for
about 30 minutes. Keep it private. Generic thumbnail/preview operations are
refused; use the named thumbnail workflow.

## Edit at the version you read

Read before editing and use its `revisionId` as the write precondition.
Revision ids are preconditions, not replay keys. `create_slide` adds an empty
slide; read its placeholder ids before inserting text. `replace_all_text`
replaces literal text. No Slides tool shares, moves or deletes the deck file.

`batch_update_presentation` takes the existing reviewed Request kinds.
The generic batch hatch uses `POST /presentations/deck1:batchUpdate` with
`body: {requests: [{insertText: {objectId: "shape1", text: "Hello"}}],
writeControl: {requiredRevisionId: "revision-from-read"}}`. It retains the
same request-kind and revision guards. No additional preview capabilities are
admitted by indexing the complete Discovery document.

## Comments can save separately

A comment thread's `commentId` identifies the thread; its head post and
replies have their own `postId`. Authors' `user` ids are stable; display names
are labels. Anchors join to page and object ids; speaker-note comments belong
to the notes page. Reading comments requires comment access. A view-only
account may be refused rather than receiving an apparently empty list.

Resolve, reopen or reassign a thread with `update_comment_thread`; edit its
text with `update_comment_post`. Reassignment requires content. Only the
post's author can edit or delete that post. Comments notify people as in the
Slides editor.

Slides saves deck changes and comment changes separately. A successful mixed
batch can save the deck without confirming the comments. When
`commentUpdateState` is not `ALL_SAVED`, or the result says comment saves are
unconfirmed, read the deck and `list_comments`, report each outcome separately,
and avoid replaying the whole batch. Keep every created id for reconciliation.

## Conventions

- **Results:** `fields` narrows a read's result to the dot paths you name. `truncated` lists the dot paths a result cut for size; the ids that fetch what was cut stay in the result.
- **Hatch:** `slides_api_search` finds this API's operations and reads no account data, `slides_api_details` shows one operation's contract, and `slides_api_read` calls a reviewed read. `slides_api_write` calls a reviewed write; the host may ask the user to confirm it. An operation without a reviewed verdict is refused; these are refused by design: `GET /presentations/{presentationId}/pages/{pageObjectId}/thumbnail`.
- **Writes:** a write is sent once and never retried. When its outcome is unknown, read the target before repeating it. Writes take no idempotency key.
- **Errors:** codes come from the vendor's statuses and error facts, never its prose. An unknown id, or one these credentials cannot reach, fails as `connector_call_failed`; this API does not tell the two apart. `conflict` means: A revision-guarded batch update returned ABORTED or FAILED_PRECONDITION with HTTP 400 or 409; The content or revision bound to a named continuation cursor changed; restart the read.
- **Withheld values:** a value withheld for safety reads `"[redacted]"`. Writes refuse whole marker values and withheld links; longer prose may mention the marker. Paths and queries refuse any containment.

tools.name: get_presentation
tools.description: Read a Google Slides deck: title, page size, revisionId, layouts, and each slide's text in reading order with speaker notes, capped per slide. Cannot find decks; that is Drive's job.

presentationId.description: Presentation id: the part after /presentation/d/ in its URL, or from Drive.

limit.description: Slides per page, 1 to 100; defaults to 20. A page also ends before ~192 KB.

cursor.description: Opaque page.nextCursor, or a textCursor-style cursor, this connection returned. Pass it back unchanged.

maxCharsPerSlide.description: Text kept per slide (notes apart), 0 to 50000; defaults to 4000. A cut gives a get_page cursor for the rest.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in the result; truncation metadata is preserved.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read one page by objectId — slide, layout, master, or notes page — every element in reading order, with placeholder ids and text continued across pages.

presentationId.description: Presentation id: the part after /presentation/d/ in its URL, or from Drive.

pageObjectId.description: A slide's, layout's, master's, or notes page's objectId.

limit.description: Elements per page, 1 to 500; defaults to 50. A page also ends before ~192 KB.

cursor.description: Opaque page.nextCursor, or a textCursor-style cursor, this connection returned. Pass it back unchanged.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in the result; truncation metadata is preserved.

tools.name: list_layouts
tools.description: List a deck's masters, each followed by its layouts, with the ids create_slide and get_page take. Names only; get_page reads a layout's placeholders.

presentationId.description: Presentation id: the part after /presentation/d/ in its URL, or from Drive.

limit.description: Masters and layouts per page, 1 to 500; defaults to 100. A page also ends before ~192 KB.

cursor.description: Opaque page.nextCursor, or a textCursor-style cursor, this connection returned. Pass it back unchanged.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in each item; truncation metadata is preserved.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List a deck's comment threads, or one page's: anchor, status, quoted text, head post, and replies, each author by user id. Long text continues across pages.

presentationId.description: Presentation id: the part after /presentation/d/ in its URL, or from Drive.

pageObjectId.description: Only this slide's or notes page's threads; omit for the whole deck.

limit.description: Threads per page, 1 to 500; defaults to 50. A page also ends before ~192 KB.

cursor.description: Opaque page.nextCursor, or a textCursor-style cursor, this connection returned. Pass it back unchanged.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in each item; truncation metadata is preserved.

tools.name: get_slide_thumbnail
tools.description: Get a PNG thumbnail link for one slide: a URL valid about 30 minutes that opens as the user, plus its size. Never downloads the image.

presentationId.description: Presentation id: the part after /presentation/d/ in its URL, or from Drive.

size.description: Width: SMALL 200px, MEDIUM 800px, LARGE 1600px, WIDTH2000_PX 2000px; Slides chooses when omitted.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in the result; truncation metadata is preserved.

tools.name: create_presentation
tools.description: Create an empty Google Slides deck with one title slide in the user's My Drive root. It cannot place the deck in a folder or copy a template.

title.description: The deck's title, as Drive shows it.

tools.name: create_slide
tools.description: Add one empty slide to a deck, from a predefined layout or one of its own layouts, at an index or the end. Adds no text; nothing existing changes.

presentationId.description: Presentation id: the part after /presentation/d/ in its URL, or from Drive.

layout.description: Predefined layout; the deck's theme must have it. Omit both layout and layoutId for BLANK.

layoutId.description: A layouts[].objectId from get_presentation, instead of layout.

insertionIndex.description: 0-based position, as get_presentation numbers slides; omit to append.

tools.name: replace_all_text
tools.description: Replace every occurrence of literal text across a deck's slides, or the slides named, in one atomic write. No regex; formatting of the replaced text is kept.

presentationId.description: Presentation id: the part after /presentation/d/ in its URL, or from Drive.

slideObjectIds.description: Limit to these slides; omit for every slide.

requiredRevisionId.description: revisionId from get_presentation; the write is refused, unapplied, if the deck changed since.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Comment on a slide, a notes page, an element, a range of its text, or a table cell, optionally assigning it. Adds a thread; Slides notifies as in the editor.

presentationId.description: Presentation id: the part after /presentation/d/ in its URL, or from Drive.

objectId.description: The page or element to comment on: the shape or table, for text or a cell.

content.description: Plain text; Slides' cap is 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

textRange.description: Anchor to this text of the shape, or of the cell: 0-based, end exclusive.

cell.description: A table cell, 0-based: with textRange, that text in it; else the whole cell.

assigneeEmail.description: Assign the thread to this address; Slides notifies them.

requiredRevisionId.description: Refuse, unapplied, if the deck changed since this revision.

tools.name: create_comment_reply
tools.description: Reply to a comment thread. Adds a post and changes no existing one; to resolve, reopen, or reassign, use update_comment_thread.

presentationId.description: Presentation id: the part after /presentation/d/ in its URL, or from Drive.

content.description: Plain text, up to 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

tools.name: update_comment_thread
tools.description: Resolve, reopen, or reassign a comment thread with a post. Pass exactly one of status or assigneeEmail; reassignment requires content. Replaces its status or assignee; Slides notifies an assignee.

presentationId.description: Presentation id: the part after /presentation/d/ in its URL, or from Drive.

status.description: Resolve the thread, or reopen it.

assigneeEmail.description: Reassign an assigned thread instead; needs content.

content.description: Note posted with it, up to 2048 UTF-8 bytes; required to reassign.

tools.name: update_comment_post
tools.description: Replace the text of one post in a comment thread, the head post or a reply. Only its author can; the old text is gone.

presentationId.description: Presentation id: the part after /presentation/d/ in its URL, or from Drive.

postId.description: postId of the post, from list_comments.

content.description: The new plain text, up to 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a whole comment thread, every reply with it. Only the author of its head post can, and the API cannot restore it.

presentationId.description: Presentation id: the part after /presentation/d/ in its URL, or from Drive.

tools.name: delete_comment_reply
tools.description: Delete one reply from a comment thread. Only its author can, and not a reply that resolved, reopened, or assigned the thread.

presentationId.description: Presentation id: the part after /presentation/d/ in its URL, or from Drive.

postId.description: postId of the reply, from list_comments.

tools.name: batch_update_presentation
tools.description: Send raw Slides batchUpdate requests to a deck at the revision it was read at; all apply or none, comments apart. Always destructive. Returns every new id; past 256 KiB, only a direct call can page them.

presentationId.description: Presentation id: the part after /presentation/d/ in its URL, or from Drive.

requiredRevisionId.description: revisionId from get_presentation; the write is refused, unapplied, if the deck changed since.

requests.description: Slides Request objects, applied in order, all or none but comments; 1 to 100 (connecta's bound).

items.description: One Request with one key, as the Slides reference defines it: {"insertText": {...}}.

tools.name: slides_api_search
tools.description: Find Google Slides API operations by keyword or path. Returns up to 8 compact matches with the tool that calls each; reads no account data.

query.description: Keywords or a path, e.g. refund charge.

cursor.description: page.nextCursor from the previous search with the same query.

tool.description: The tool that calls it; absent when refused.

named.description: A named tool serving this operation with a projected result; prefer it.

matched.description: The request or response field this operation was found by; call its tool to read the field.

truncated.description: Entry labels cut for size; slides_api_details on that method and path returns them whole.

tools.name: slides_api_details
tools.description: Read one Google Slides API operation's request contract: path, query and body parameters with types and required names. Reads no account data.

path.description: The path template from search, or a concrete path.

param.description: Return only this parameter, in full.

cursor.description: page.nextCursor from the previous details call with the same method, path and param.

body.description: Body content type and schema. When paged: this page's properties, the required names it delivers or chunks, and the schema's other keywords on the page that carries them.

tool.description: The tool that calls it; absent when refused.

named.description: A named tool serving this operation with a projected result; prefer it.

of.description: The piece this text belongs to, such as parameters.limit.

text.description: Part of that piece's JSON; join the parts in page order, then parse them.

truncated.description: Labels cut for size; their full text arrives as chunks.

page.description: Present when the contract exceeds one answer: pass nextCursor back for the next pieces.

tools.name: slides_api_read
tools.description: Call a reviewed Google Slides API read. The operation index checks arguments before anything is sent.

path.description: Concrete path from search with ids filled in, e.g. /presentations/deck1. No query string.

query.description: Query parameters as JSON, named as details lists them.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in data, applied to each item of an array, after value safety and privacy filtering.

cursor.description: Opaque page.nextCursor from this same read; omit raw query anchors when continuing.

data.description: Response body after value safety and the connection's privacy filtering.

tools.name: slides_api_write
tools.description: Call a reviewed Google Slides API write; method and path are stated for approval, and the operation index checks arguments first.

path.description: Concrete path from search with ids filled in, e.g. /presentations/deck1. No query string.

query.description: Query parameters as JSON, named as details lists them.

body.description: Request body as JSON fields, named as details lists them; form operations are encoded for you.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in data, applied to each item of an array, after value safety and privacy filtering.

data.description: Response body after value safety and the connection's privacy filtering.
